after_all_hits.effective_fact: Master pbUseMove calls after-all-hits outside the hit loop once per original target entry after reached post-loop processing. It is distinct from per-hit pbProcessMoveHit callbacks. Delivery is not necessarily a successful effect: each family and central qualification controls changes.
after_all_hits.controls: Scale Shot ordinary two-hit fixture yields one Defense−1 then Speed+1 request, not two. A miss can leave zero successful hits yet still reach post-loop delivery; unaffected can suppress effect. Earlier whole-use return never reaches it. Prefix writes survive a later failure; no all-callback shared-guard claim.
after_all_hits.root_disposition: GR8-CAR-CAND-004 NO_REQUIRED_BOUNDED_SCOPE; correct combined WP40/WP46 retained; no new required/optional/vote.
